method: Direct manual inspection of the existing full 1600 × 720 immutable WebP payloads using tools.view_image with detail=original; all returned image data forwarded to the reviewer at original detail, once per distinct payload.

observations.state: Table style picker in left split pane
observations.observation: The left split pane shows the Table style dialog with Standard table selected and the full 2D table, 3D table, and Done labels visible. The explanatory text directly below the title is vertically clipped to tiny lower glyph fragments. Android Display settings fills the right pane. The dim app background shows no private card face.
observations.layout_note: Explanatory copy is clipped in the modal content viewport; these stills do not show scrolling or establish reachability.

observations.state: Opaque privacy cover in left split pane
observations.observation: The picker is replaced by a full opaque dark left app pane reading Your cards stay private. No native toolbar, hand, selection, or private card face is visible. Android Display settings remains in the right pane.
observations.layout_note: Privacy label fits the available pane.

observations.observation: The left app pane is a blank opaque dark surface beneath the system bar; no privacy label, toolbar, scene, or private card face is visible. The right Settings pane remains visible.
observations.layout_note: Transient blank app surface in captured order.

observations.state: Opening native table with opaque stage
observations.observation: The left split pane shows Opening table... and fully visible Standard table and Leave table controls. Standard table wraps to two lines. The lower stage remains opaque and reads Your cards stay private. Android Display settings remains on the right.
observations.layout_note: Toolbar text and both controls fit; the Standard table button is taller because its label wraps.

observations.state: Native privacy status and opaque stage
observations.observation: Both the native toolbar status and opaque stage read Your cards stay private. Standard table and Leave table remain fully visible. No hand or private face appears.
observations.layout_note: Visible toolbar labels fit within the split pane.

observations.state: Ready native table in left split pane; hand outside viewport
observations.observation: The left split pane shows Table ready., Standard table, Leave table, the engine Exit button, and Your turn · Moon table wrapped over two lines. The hand, covered-card count, and hand-reveal control are not visible below this content. Android Display settings remains on the right. No private face or selection appears in the visible portion.
observations.layout_note: The large native turn heading consumes the remaining split-pane height; the hand area lies outside the captured viewport. Scrolling, offscreen concealment, and control activation are not established by these frames.

observations.state: Ready split pane before fullscreen closing
observations.observation: The same split-pane Table ready surface remains: Standard table, Leave table, Exit, and the wrapped Your turn · Moon table heading. The system navigation strip lightens across these frames. The hand remains outside the captured pane viewport, with no private face or selection visible.
observations.layout_note: The same below-viewport hand limitation persists.

observations.state: Fullscreen Closing table with opaque stage
observations.observation: The first captured fullscreen app frame is 45, also the first captured Closing table... state. Settings and the split divider disappear. Both toolbar actions are visibly dimmed; the enlarged stage is opaque with Your cards stay private. No ready native hand, card face, selection, or Leave dialog appears during these represented closing frames.
observations.layout_note: The fullscreen closing toolbar and privacy label fit.

observations.state: Fullscreen opaque privacy cover without toolbar
observations.observation: The closing toolbar disappears and the fullscreen app is an opaque dark surface reading Your cards stay private. No card face, selection, native scene, or Leave dialog is visible.

observations.state: Returned fullscreen Compose table; hand outside viewport
observations.observation: First captured Compose return is frame 54. Across frames 54–58, the fullscreen landscape page shows Last Light, Table style, Your turn, Moon table, ROUND 1, Set the tone., and Play 1–3 cards and claim the table rank. The hand and Show hand control are below the captured viewport throughout. No private face, selection, or Leave dialog is visible.
observations.layout_note: The returned page is at its top with the hand out of view; the visible text fits in these frames.

excluded_actions: No media decoding, captures, crop/resize, downloads, builds, or non-owned source edits.
